points.point: Your university, as your Student sponsor, must report to the Home Office that you are finishing early with the lower-level qualification (the bachelor's degree).
The Home Office will normally cancel (cut short) your Student permission, so that it ends in line with the new, earlier end date of your studies and not on its original date.
To switch from a Student visa to a Skilled Worker visa, you must have completed the course you were sponsored to study, or your job start date must be after your course has finished.
Leaving an integrated master's programme with the lower-level qualification (the bachelor's degree) still counts as completing your course for the switch to a Skilled Worker visa.
